name: rss
author: cristian-milea
description: Latest headlines from any RSS or Atom feed.
long_description: Reads any RSS or Atom feed directly — no third-party proxy — and shows the latest headlines on the e-ink. Prefer an https feed URL; some hosts block requests without a browser-like User-Agent. Choose a vertical or horizontal headline layout from the phone. Feeds that embed full article bodies can be large (~1 MB) and may sync slowly over Bluetooth — a lightweight headlines-only feed works best.

secrets.label: Feed URL
secrets.description: RSS or Atom feed address, e.g. https://site.com/feed/
